scriptData.label: @effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
The sling bullet rings your bell, leaving a shilling-sized thick flap of skin winking open above one eye. Blood starts pouring down your face and into your eyes.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (1) and @Condition[Blinded] (2), the latter of which cannot be removed until the @Condition[Bleeding] Condition has been removed. Also roll for any Pummel Quality.
